_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC (gaps filled through 05007038) by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

Options031D.7: engine/ignition variant used by the event, spark, knock and rpm code
Options031D.6: engine variant used by the event, fuel accounting and misfire code (cylinder layout, probably)
Options031D.5: hardware set-up variant at reset (Reset, HardwareCheck)

Options031E.7: A/C pressure sensor fitted, not a switch (AcPressureSensor): idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan
Options031E.4: fuel level from the bus instead of the sender, probably
Options031E.3: power steering pressure switch fitted (sets EquipmentFlags bit 2)

Options0321.4: PWM fan output: output-compare set-up at reset and in the PIT code

Options0323.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkOn); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, CamSignalCheck)
Options0323.2: part-throttle fuel: MAP is held at the first x point of PartThrottleMapScale as a minimum (CalcFuelPulse)
Options0323.0: idle dip kick mode (IdleDipKickMode); also EquipmentInit and EquipmentDetect

Options0324.7: closed loop off: ClosedLoopMain clears the O2 state and the short-term trim
Options0324.6: flex-fuel (ethanol) calibration: FlexEthanol and the flex learning are used

Options0325.6: manual transmission: GearStateUpdate and the park/neutral monitor are skipped
Options0325.5: transmission controller on the bus (sets EquipmentFlags bit 5)
Options0325.2: PCI bus (SAE J1850 VPW) instead of CCD: PciReceive / PciPitTick run instead of CcdReceive / CcdTransmit

Options0326.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)
Options0326.0: start injector / spark variant (StartInjectorPulse, FinishFuelPulse, SparkEventCalc)

Options032D.5: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant
